text: Fixed native total_sigma=0.5 replication completed on both declared observed pairs. OASIS 13→14 converges at 16/35/40 iterations, Dice 0.476786, HD95 4.5 mm, max brain round trip 0.198227 mm, minimum sampled cell J 0.358767. OASIS 15→16 converges at 19/51/22, Dice 0.450387, HD95 5.796493 mm, round trip 0.196846 mm, minimum cell J 0.389404. Both have coverage 1 and zero sampled folds. Including the pilot, fixed-setting convergence/geometry passes 3/3; mean Dice 0.469622 vs frozen HalfFlow 0.413943 and HD95 5.199577 vs 5.253667 mm. This establishes an observed small-panel gap against a geometry-admitted converged reference, not a generally validated reference or qualification result. Margins are narrow (minimum round-trip slack 0.00177 mm); additional cohorts, prospective scoring and isolated timings remain needed. Both new outcomes, logs and reports are archived in regularized-replication-outcomes-v1 under docs/benchmarks/evidence/halfflow-reference-20261014. P02 remains open.
